question: Why can an assistant referee with perfect eyesight still misjudge offside from where he stands?
answer: Geometry. Unless the assistant is exactly level with the second-last defender, the offside line is seen at a slant, so players on the far side of the pitch appear shifted towards or away from goal. A study of 200 real decisions found 40 wrong, in the directions the viewing angle predicted.
move: Before trusting a judgement of level, check where the judge was standing.

diagram.caption: 40 of 200 real decisions were wrong: one in five, as the viewing angle predicted.
